matching: one-to-one greedy descending IoU, ties ascending stable A/B IDs
geometry_rule: buffer(0) repair of invalid polygons with an audit; no site boundary clipping in rater agreement
primary_annotation_view: class-restricted tree F1 and matched crown median IoU, with denominators
other_views: all-class pooled agreement, each class separately, per-site results, confusion and matched-class Cohen kappa
kappa_scope: pooled spatially matched class pairs only; does not include absent background, unmatched objects or true-negative counts
adjudication: manual after original independent comparison; never automatically freeze or overwrite original labels
limitations: Two sites cover only small_subcanopy and canopy_edge; hard negatives are selective, not exhaustive. Rater agreement is not model performance. Undefined denominators/kappa remain null.
